notes.title: Spectromancer for iPad works again!
notes.content: After iOS 16 release Spectromancer became unplayable and broken on iPad tablets. Finally, the game is repaired and updated, so now it works as it should!

notes.title: Chinese version crash fixed
notes.content: Fixed crash issue on game load when  Chinese language is selected.

notes.title: Custom DRM removed.
notes.content:
We have removed our custom activation-based DRM. Forget about activation codes - you no longer need  them. And it doesn't depend on the game server anymore. All the game features are available from start.

In addition, the game has been improved to work correctly on high DPI screens (like 4K monitors) in full screen mode.

P.S. This update applies to the latest version of the game: Gathering of Power. Old versions are not modified.

notes.title: Astral Towers released on Steam for the first time
notes.content:
Astral Towers is a card game with "one turn - one action" mechanic - like Spectromancer. But this is mostly an adventure game: there are 89 missions at 2 difficulty levels. 

The original game was made in 2011. It was English-only and designed for 1366x768 screen resolution, so it doesn't look great in full screen. Now the remastered edition has improved graphics designed for up to 4K screen resolution. 

Other changes:
[list]
[*] Improved UI and visualization.
[*] Full support for Russian language.
[*] Improved campaign balance based on actual stats.
[*] Steam achievements.
[*] No DRM, no any activations!
[/list]
I hope you'll like it and post a review! :-)

Game page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/983450/Astral_Towers/

notes.title: The game engine is made open source
notes.content:
The game engine behind Spectromancer and Astral Heroes games is made open source and published at GitHub: https://github.com/Cooler2/ApusGameEngine

I've also published source code of some demo projects including Astral Heroes website, game backup/analytics tool, game auto-updater. They're available at the GitHub too: https://github.com/Cooler2/ApusEngineExamples

This became possible because of support I've got at Patreon. Now we're very close to the second goal: the source code of the Astral Heroes game server will be published. You're welcome to support this development - just become a patron to make this happen: https://www.patreon.com/ApusGameEngine

notes.title: Spectromancer: Gathering of Power DLC Now Available
notes.content:
Spectromancer: Gathering of Power DLC, all new content for Spectromancer is now available on Steam.

Gathering of Power expansion introduces 4 new classes: Warrior Priest, Vampire Lord, Cultist and Golem Master.

Other improvements:

-Visual appearance of the game in fullscreen mode was improved (especially in Windows 7).
-Campaign was changed. Players now start the campaign with all cards unlocked, and learn upgrades to the cards during the campaign. Upgraded versions of cards are available in the campaign only.
-Now it is possible to select cards and slots with arrow keys (useful on laptops).
-Blitz duels were implemented in the online league. Each player has 15 seconds for their turn - these battles are quick as lightning!
-Good news for players with unreliable internet connections: now it is possible to reconnect after a broken connection and finish the duel.

notes.title: Now Available - Spectromancer: Truth & Beauty Expansion
notes.content:
Spectromancer: Truth & Beauty Expansion is now available on Steam.

Prove your deck-making skills by drafting cards in the new Spectromancer expansion! Truth and Beauty is the second expansion for this online fantasy card game, and it features three new mage classes which can be used in online play, the original campaign, the League of Heroes, or the new Draft Tournament mode.

For those who've never experienced Spectromancer, do not fret. To commemorate the release of the second expansion, Steam is also offering a bundle pack that includes the original game and two expansions at an affordable price.
